Wings of Grace" ], "layer": [ "The Elyos–Asmodian War ended with the fall of the Aion Tower. The barrier could not hold under the weight of strife and the world was consumed by the final flames of war, forever known as the Last War.", "As the Tower fell and the barrier faded, the Balaur descended upon Elysea. The Empyrean Lords sacrificed themselves to forge a wall of light, sealing the world in a radiant veil of eternal isolation.", "The Bulwark rose through endless sacrifice, consuming Siel and draining the remaining Lords, leaving some destroyed and others hollowed of their light.", "With the barrier gone, Atreia fell into war as Dragon Lords Ishtar and Fafnir engulfed Poeta in fire and shadow, leaving countless lives in ruin.", "Beyond the Bulwark, a Daeva’s Ascension was no longer a blessing. Now they were hunted, bound to Surana, and reshaped into aberrations that turned on their own kind." ] }, { "title": "Asmodians", "description": [ "Forged in Shadows,
Wings of Dominion" ], "layer": [ "The Elyos–Asmodian War ended with the fall of the Aion Tower. The barrier could not hold under the weight of strife and the world was consumed by the final flames of war, forever known as the Last War.", "When the barrier fell, Asmodae was left defenseless as the Balaur surged in like an endless tide. In their final stand, the Empyrean Lords raised a wall of light, sealing the realm in shadow.", "With Israphel fallen, the five remaining Empyrean Lords gave everything, forging the Bulwark from their blood and souls as Asmodae’s final shield.", "Beyond the Bulwark lay a world ripe for conquest, as Dragon Lords Ishtar and Fafnir crushed Ishalgen and devoured the continent. Though the Bulwark halted their advance, the land beyond remained under their dominion.", "The Daeva, once destined for light, were consumed by darkness as Fafnir shattered their souls and sealed their light in crystal prisons, turning them into harbingers of destruction." ] } ], "lore": { "elyos": [ { "title": "Collapsed AION Tower", "description": [ "At the end of the Elyos-Asmodian
War, the AION Tower collapsed.
Amidst the deepening mistrust, the barrier could
not be formed, and the
conflict between the three
factions ultimately plunged the world into darkness.
The tragedy of that day would later
come to be known as the Last War." ] }, { "title": "A Fractured World", "description": [ "On the day the tower fell and the barrier
vanished, the Balaur descended upon Elysea,
and the remaining Empyrean Lords summoned
the last of their strength to raise a wall.
Stretching between Eltnen and Interdika,
the Bulwark
divided the world, leaving
Elysea shrouded in silent isolation." ] }, { "title": "Siel's Absence,
A Line Drawn in Blood", "description": [ "Like the sacrifice of the Empyrean Lord
who once protected the
world in ages past,
the Bulwark was born of painful sacrifice.
Siel, guardian of the tower, was already gone,
and the five remaining
Empyrean Lords poured
the last of their power into completing the wall.
At last, the Bulwark stood, but at a terrible cost.
Some of the Lords perished completely, while others
silently faded, their radiance forever extinguished." ] }, { "title": "Shadow of the Dragon Lord", "description": [ "The moment the barrier vanished,
Atreia became a gruesome battlefield.
The new Dragon Lord, Ishtar, unleashed her
boundless fury, her flames consuming Poeta.
Beyond Elysea's Bulwark, countless lives
were lost beneath her merciless advance." ] }, { "title": "Corrupted Blessing,
The Fall of the Daeva", "description": [ "Beyond the Bulwark, the Ascension
of a Daeva was no longer a blessing.
Under Ishtar’s command, Daeva were hunted
down and used as fuel to make Surana.
Those subjected to her experiments were
ultimately resurrected as
twisted mutants,
forced to turn their swords against their own kin.
The light that once heralded a blessing had
been completely consumed by a terrible curse." ] } ], "asmodians": [ { "title": "Collapsed AION Tower", "description": [ "At the end of the Elyos-Asmodian
War, the AION Tower collapsed.
Amidst the deepening mistrust, the barrier could
not be formed, and the
conflict between the three
factions ultimately plunged the world into darkness.
The tragedy of that day would later
come to be known as the Last War." ] }, { "title": "The Severed World", "description": [ "On the day the barrier vanished,
Asmodae was stripped of its defenses.
The Balaur surged through the darkness, swallowing
everything in their path like a merciless tide.
The Empyrean Lords gathered the last
sparks of their power to raise a Bulwark
between Morheim and Belluslan, sealing
Asmodae away in silence and shadow." ] }, { "title": "Israphel's Absence,
A Wall Forged in Blood", "description": [ "Israphel was no more, and the remaining five
Empyrean Lords ignited the last of their power.
Forged from their blood and souls, the
Bulwark became Asmodae’s shield.
That wall of solitude was raised in blood and light." ] }, { "title": "The Era of the New Dragon Lord", "description": [ "The world beyond the Bulwark, stripped of
its shield, became a land ripe for destruction.
The newly risen Dragon Lord Fafnir descended upon
Ishalgen, his forces sweeping across the continent.
His advance was halted when the
Bulwark was completed, but the
sacrifices of the nameless never ceased.
Thus, the lands beyond the Bulwark
fell beneath the heel of the Balaur." ] }, { "title": "Fafnite, Torn Souls", "description": [ "Daeva who were meant to awaken into the
light were instead swallowed by darkness.
Fafnir tore their souls asunder, trapping
what little light remained within jewels.
Those who once carried the breath of a god
became hollow
heralds of ruin, no longer
guardians, but harbingers of destruction." ] } ], "pagination": [ "Collapsed
AION Tower", "Divided Atreia", "Death of the
Empyrean Lord", "Age of the New
Dragon Lords", "Daeva" ] }, "combat": [ { "title": "COMBAT", "description": [ "Experience fast, flued combat with action dodges,
precision aiming, and dynamic targeting." ] } ], "flight": [ { "title": "FLIGHT", "description": [ "Soar without limits and explore any
terrain or space with complete freedom." ] } ], "dungeons": [ { "title": "DUNGEONS", "description": [ "Over 200 dungeons span multiple
formats: solo challenges,
5-player party
content, and 10-player group dungeons." ] } ], "classes": [ { "title": "Gladiator", "description": [ "A frontline vanguard who carries a colossal blade
and tears through the battlefield like a raging storm" ] }, { "title": "Templar", "description": [ "A sworn guardian who stands firm like a fortress wall,
holding the battlefield with an unbreakable shield" ] }, { "title": "Assassin", "description": [ "A cold-blooded assassin who cuts through darkness
and approaches unseen with deadly silence" ] }, { "title": "Ranger", "description": [ "A quiet hunter who commands the
battlefield with a single, decisive shot" ] }, { "title": "Chanter", "description": [ "A venerable guardian who bolsters allies with
divine blessings and steadfast protection" ] }, { "title": "Cleric", "description": [ "A holy shepherd who preserves
life with the gentle touch of light" ] }, { "title": "Sorcerer", "description": [ "A harbinger of ruin who devours
all with a storm of arcane power" ] }, { "title": "Spiritmaster", "description": [ "A herald of spirits who commands
the battlefield with elemental power" ] } ], "elyos": [ { "title": "Dawn Legion Base", "description": [ "A hidden Dawn Legion base in Verteron’s Cantas
Valley, concealed
within a secluded ravine
and used as their secret command center." ] }, { "title": "Cantas Valley", "description": [ "Once a vital Odylium hub for the Daeva, this
abandoned land was left barren
after depletion, now
scavenged by the Dawn Legion for remaining traces." ] }, { "title": "Ellun River Marsh", "description": [ "A ruined swamp downstream of the Ellun
River, now occupied by
the Illusion Cavaliers
as they rebuild Verteron’s fallen Barrier Tower." ] }, { "title": "Aullaeu Village", "description": [ "An Aullaeu settlement at Tolbas Forest’s edge,
home
to Balaur servants and a source of the forest’s unrest." ] }, { "title": "Altamia Canyon", "description": [ "A submerged canyon in eastern Verteron,
once home to the
Zumion Temple, now
resurfaced under the Notos Legion’s watch." ] } ], "asmodians": [ { "title": "Safe Haven", "description": [ "A former haven for criminals in northern
Altgard, now an unlikely
refuge untouched
by Balaur assaults after the Dredgion’s fall." ] }, { "title": "Dredgion Crash Site", "description": [ "A scorched canyon where a Fafnir Legion
Dredgion crashed, leaking
Drakana that corrupted
the land and left the area dangerously isolated." ] }, { "title": "Sanctum Outpost", "description": [ "Once a sacred sanctuary of the Empyrean
Lord Zikel, this fallen land is now a Balaur
stronghold where Draconute Warriors
transform captured Daevas into Fafnites." ] }, { "title": "Moslan Forest", "description": [ "Once a thriving sanctuary of the Elim and Nornir,
this forest was consumed
by Hystan’s flames,
leaving only wounded Elim among the ashes." ] }, { "title": "Nornir Assembly", "description": [ "A hidden Nornir settlement built by refugees
of Moslan Forest, protected
by ancient magic
and guided by Urd of the Three Sisters of Fate." ] } ], "customization": [ { "title": "CUSTOMIZATION", "description": [ "Express yourself with over 200 customization options
and countless outfits, mounts, and wings to collect." ] } ], "pet": [ { "title": "PET", "description": [ "Collect lovable companions that follow you
around, transform into
rideable mounts, and
provide useful benefits such as auto-looting." ] } ], "expedition": [ { "title": "Krao Cave", "description": [ "A cavern where the legacy of war lies in slumber.
The seal is broken by greed, and
together with the
experiment subject
“Berk,” a calamity awakens once more.
The Daevas dispatch a strike force to
put an end to the nightmare of the past." ] }, { "title": "Urugugu Canyon", "description": [ "Deep within the Tolbas Canyon lies a
sacred sanctuary revered
by a tribe that
believes it to be the domain of the gods.
At its heart is said to slumber the divine bird, “Auldor,”
a divine being summoned via draconic power." ] }, { "title": "Fire Temple", "description": [ "A temple built within a lava cavern, where the
gods are said to have hidden their treasures.
Beyond the traps and vigilant guardians
lies an altar at the journey’s end.
There, a sentient mirror whispers:
“Can you resist this temptation?”" ] }, { "title": "Draupnir", "description": [ "Beyond the shattered portal, the Draupnir Cave is
slowly being consumed by an unknown dimension.
There, Bakarma absorbs an alien and corrupting
power, and at the far
edge of that collapsing
realm, he is reborn as a “new Dragon Lord.”" ] } ]}
